verdict.rationale: The docs confirm that Copilot integrates with JetBrains IDEs and that chat works in JetBrains. They also say that in-editor Copilot proposes edits and edits workspace files in agent mode. That implies some in-IDE edit review and context sharing, but nothing ties interactive diffs or selected-code context to JetBrains specifically. An old community note about JetBrains missing from a preview does not contradict current support. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of interactive diff views in JetBrains, explicit documentation of sharing a selected code snippet as chat context in JetBrains, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
